text_en: Now the boy Samuel was ministering to the Lord under Eli. The word of the Lord was rare in those days; visions were not widespread.
text_cn: 小撒慕尔在厄里面前服事上主；那时，上主的话少有，异象也罕见。

text_en: At that time Eli, whose eyesight had begun to grow dim so that he could not see, was lying down in his room;
text_cn: 有一天，厄里睡在自己的房里，他的眼睛渐渐昏花，已看不清了，

text_en: the lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the temple of the Lord , where the ark of God was.
text_cn: 天主的灯尚未熄灭，撒慕尔睡在安放天主约柜的上主的殿内。

text_en: Then the Lord called, “Samuel! Samuel! ” and he said, “Here I am! ”
text_cn: 那时，上主召叫说：“撒慕尔，撒慕尔！”他回答说：“我在这里﹗”

text_en: and ran to Eli, and said, “Here I am, for you called me. ” But he said, “I did not call; lie down again. ” So he went and lay down.
text_cn: 他就跑到厄里前说道：“你叫了我，我在这里。”厄里说：“我没有叫你，回去睡吧！”他就回去睡了。

text_en: The Lord called again, “Samuel! ” Samuel got up and went to Eli, and said, “Here I am, for you called me. ” But he said, “I did not call, my son; lie down again. ”
text_cn: 上主又叫撒慕尔；撒慕尔起来，走到厄里那里说道：“你叫了我，我在这里。”厄里对他说：“我儿，我没有叫你，回去睡吧！”

text_en: Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord , and the word of the Lord had not yet been revealed to him.
text_cn: 撒慕尔不知道是上主，因为上主的话尚未启示给他。

text_en: The Lord called Samuel again, a third time. And he got up and went to Eli, and said, “Here I am, for you called me. ” Then Eli perceived that the Lord was calling the boy.
text_cn: 上主第三次又叫了撒慕尔；他起来，又走到厄里那里说道：“你叫了我，我在这里。”厄里于是明白，是上主叫了幼童，

text_en: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down; and if he calls you, you shall say, ‘Speak, Lord , for your servant is listening. ’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
text_cn: 便对撒慕尔说：“去睡吧！假使有人再叫你，你就回答说：请上主发言，你的仆人在此静听。”撒慕尔就回去，仍睡在原处。

text_en: Now the Lord came and stood there, calling as before, “Samuel! Samuel! ” And Samuel said, “Speak, for your servant is listening. ”
text_cn: 上主走近，像前几次一样召叫说：“撒慕尔，撒慕尔！”撒慕尔便回答说：“请上主发言！你的仆人在此静听。”

text_en: Then the Lord said to Samuel, “See, I am about to do something in Israel that will make both ears of anyone who hears of it tingle.
text_cn: 上主遂对撒慕尔说：“看！我要在以色列行一件事，凡听见的人，他的两耳必要嗡嗡作响。

text_en: On that day I will fulfill against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from beginning to end.
text_cn: 到那一天，我必对厄里从头到尾实践我论他的家族所说的一切话。

text_en: For I have told him that I am about to punish his house forever, for the iniquity that he knew, because his sons were blaspheming God, and he did not restrain them.
text_cn: 你传报给他：我要处罚他的家族直到永远，因为他原知道他的两个儿子凌辱了天主，却未责斥他们。

text_en: Therefore I swear to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be expiated by sacrifice or offering forever. ”
text_cn: 因此，我对厄里的家族起誓：无论牺牲或供物，永不能抹去厄里一家的罪过。”

text_en: Samuel lay there until morning; then he opened the doors of the house of the Lord . Samuel was afraid to tell the vision to Eli.
text_cn: 撒慕尔睡到早晨起来，开了上主圣殿的门；但害怕告诉厄里他所见的异象。

text_en: But Eli called Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son. ” He said, “Here I am. ”
text_cn: 厄里却对撒慕尔说：“撒慕尔，我儿！”他回答说：“我在这里。”

text_en: Eli said, “What was it that he told you? Do not hide it from me. May God do so to you and more also, if you hide anything from me of all that he told you. ”
text_cn: 厄里问说：“上主给你说了什么话，请不要隐瞒我！你若把上主给你说的话，给我隐瞒了一句，愿天主加倍惩罚你。”

text_en: So Samuel told him everything and hid nothing from him. Then he said, “It is the Lord ; let him do what seems good to him. ”
text_cn: 撒慕尔便把那些话全告诉了他，一句也没有隐瞒。厄里说：“他是上主，他看着怎样好，就怎样行吧！”

text_en: As Samuel grew up, the Lord was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.
text_cn: 撒慕尔渐渐长大；上主与他同在，使他说的一切话，没有一句落空。

text_en: And all Israel from Dan to Beer-sheba knew that Samuel was a trustworthy prophet of the Lord .
text_cn: 于是全以色列从丹直到贝尔舍巴，都知道撒慕尔被立为上主的先知。

text_en: The Lord continued to appear at Shiloh, for the Lord revealed himself to Samuel at Shiloh by the word of the Lord .
text_cn: 自从上主在史罗对撒慕尔显现后，继续在史罗显现于他。
